news.headline: U.S. Officials Believed Israel Was Plotting to Kill Iranian Negotiators
news.summary: Any Israeli attempt to kill Abbas Araghchi, the foreign minister, or Mohammad Ghalibaf, the Parliament speaker, would have derailed peace talks, American officials feared.
